message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep for the Products.txt list, covering credible vulnerability reports and material updates observed in the 24-hour window before the scheduled run on 2026-07-23 at 05:10 IST. Relevant fresh findings were identified for Adobe Acrobat, Google Chrome, Ubuntu/snapd, Hikvision, MongoDB, SolarWinds Serv-U, and WordPress.

**Finding 1: Adobe Acrobat PDF Extension for Chrome data disclosure**

- Product: Adobe Acrobat / Adobe Acrobat PDF Extension for Chrome
- Issue: CVE-2026-48294, also reported as HermeticReader
- Severity: CVSS 7.4 / High in public reporting; NVD lists the CNA vector and notes NVD enrichment is still pending.
- Description: Researchers disclosed a now-patched UXSS-class cross-origin data disclosure chain in the Adobe Acrobat Chrome extension. A malicious or compromised page could abuse the extension's privileged messaging path to access data from a victim browser session, with public reporting focused on exposed WhatsApp Web content.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes Adobe Acrobat and Google Chrome. The affected component is Adobe's Acrobat PDF extension for Chrome, not just standalone Acrobat Reader.
- Source: The Hacker News, 2026-07-22: https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/adobe-acrobat-extension-flaw-let.html ; NVD: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-48294

**Finding 2: Google Chrome desktop security update**

- Product: Google Chrome
- Issue: 12 high-severity Chromium/Chrome CVEs, including CVE-2026-16413 through CVE-2026-16424
- Severity: High for the listed CVEs.
- Description: Chrome 150.0.7871.181/.182 for Windows and macOS and 150.0.7871.181 for Linux addresses flaws across WebAudio, ANGLE, Chromecast, Extensions, Skia, V8, Certificate handling, UI, and GPU components. Google had not confirmed active exploitation in the reviewed reporting.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes Google Chrome, and the release applies to Chrome desktop platforms commonly present in enterprise fleets.
- Source: Google Chrome Releases, 2026-07-21: https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/ ; GBHackers summary, 2026-07-22: https://gbhackers.com/google-chrome-update-fixes-12-high-severity-vulnerabilities-that-enable-browser-attacks/

**Finding 3: Ubuntu snapd / snap-confine privilege escalation**

- Product: Ubuntu / snapd
- Issue: CVE-2026-8933, with related snapd fixes CVE-2026-15226 and CVE-2024-5300 in USN-8579-1
- Severity: CVSS 7.8 / High for CVE-2026-8933 in the NVD CNA score.
- Description: Canonical fixed a snap-confine issue where a local attacker could create attacker-controlled files in privileged locations and potentially escalate privileges to root on affected Ubuntu releases.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes Ubuntu. The affected package is snapd/snap-confine on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, 24.04 LTS, and 26.04 LTS for CVE-2026-8933.
- Source: Ubuntu USN-8579-1: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8579-1 ; NVD: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-8933

**Finding 4: Hikvision camera sensitive-data disclosure**

- Product: Hikvision cameras
- Issue: CVE-2026-57600
- Severity: CVSS vector is present in NVD/CNA data; NVD severity enrichment was still in progress in the reviewed page.
- Description: Hikvision disclosed insufficient input validation in firmware for some camera series that could allow unauthenticated attackers to retrieve partial sensitive data.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes Hikvision, and the NVD record explicitly identifies Hikvision DS-2CD, DS-2DE, DS-2DP, and DS-2TD camera series as affected.
- Source: NVD, published 2026-07-22: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-57600

**Finding 5: MongoDB Server and MongoDB Compass CVE batch**

- Product: MongoDB Server / MongoDB Compass
- Issue: Multiple CVEs published 2026-07-22, including CVE-2026-9737 and CVE-2026-13058 through CVE-2026-13078
- Severity: Mixed; Tenable/NVD-derived entries include High and Critical items, including CVE-2026-13072 listed as Critical in CVSS v4.
- Description: The new MongoDB set includes denial-of-service conditions, information disclosure, unauthorized read/write scenarios, server-side JavaScript issues, Queryable Encryption/resource-exhaustion issues, and a MongoDB Compass import/OIDC command-handling issue. Most server issues require authenticated access or specific configuration, while a few describe unauthenticated or non-default scenarios.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes MongoDB. The affected components are MongoDB Server, mongod/mongos-related behavior, and MongoDB Compass, which are directly within the MongoDB product family.
- Source: Tenable CVE feed showing 2026-07-22 MongoDB entries and MongoDB Jira references: https://www.tenable.com/cve ; example NVD entry: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-9737

**Finding 6: SolarWinds Serv-U 2026.3 vulnerability batch**

- Product: SolarWinds Serv-U
- Issue: Multiple CVEs including CVE-2026-28302, CVE-2026-28304 through CVE-2026-28317, and CVE-2026-28321
- Severity: Mostly Critical, CVSS 9.1; CVE-2026-28315 is Medium at 6.2 in SolarWinds release notes.
- Description: SolarWinds Serv-U 2026.3 fixes a batch of access-control, IDOR, privilege-escalation, account-takeover, and remote-code-execution issues. Several require group/domain administrator or authenticated access, and SolarWinds notes lower impact on Windows deployments for many of them.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes SolarWinds. Serv-U is a SolarWinds file-transfer product, so this is a clear SolarWinds-family match.
- Source: SolarWinds Serv-U 2026.3 release notes: https://documentation.solarwinds.com/en/success_center/servu/content/release_notes/servu_2026-3_release_notes.htm ; NVD example: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-28302

**Finding 7: WordPress Core wp2shell exploitation update**

- Product: WordPress
- Issue: CVE-2026-63030 and CVE-2026-60137, commonly discussed as the wp2shell chain
- Severity: Critical/High depending on source and scoring body; NVD shows WPScan critical scoring for CVE-2026-63030 and mixed scoring for CVE-2026-60137.
- Description: Although the CVEs were initially published earlier, fresh July 22 reporting and Rapid7's update noted public technical details, proof-of-concept availability, and CISA KEV addition for the chain. The combined flaws can turn a WordPress Core REST API route-confusion issue and SQL injection into unauthenticated site compromise under affected versions.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes WordPress, and the finding is specific to WordPress Core rather than a loosely related plugin.
- Source: Rapid7 update, 2026-07-22: https://www.rapid7.com/blog/post/etr-cve-2026-63030-wp2shell-a-critical-remote-code-execution-vulnerability-in-wordpress-core/ ; NVD CVE-2026-63030: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-63030 ; NVD CVE-2026-60137: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-60137

**Possible matches needing review**

- Ubiquiti/UniFi: Search results referenced UniFi OS issues in the same news cycle, but the clearly available official advisory located during this run was published on 2026-07-02, outside the freshness window. I did not include it as a confirmed new finding.
- Microsoft Edge: The Chrome/Chromium CVEs may later appear in Edge-specific updates, but I did not find a fresh Microsoft/Edge advisory in the reviewed sources that clearly placed Edge in scope for this 24-hour window.

Closing note: Immediate review is recommended for internet-facing WordPress, SolarWinds Serv-U, Hikvision camera, and MongoDB deployments, and for broad endpoint update coverage for Adobe Acrobat's Chrome extension, Chrome, and Ubuntu snapd. No fresh, credible, clearly product-matched findings were verified for the remaining monitored products in this run.
